description:
Filter associations by evidence datatype and save to parquet file.
Data: Open Targets Platform 25.09 · table association_by_datatype_direct — one record = one direct target-disease association score within one data type.
Key: diseaseId, targetId, datatypeId.
Arguments: target_id accepts ensembl gene or hgnc symbol (resolved; unknown -> error); disease_id accepts ot disease or disease name (resolved; unknown -> error).
Results: ranked by score desc within datatypeId (upstream sorts every match); `_vbt.total` counts all matches.
Rows with unknown score are excluded and counted in `_vbt.excluded_unknown`.
Empty vs not found: unknown identifiers are errors; an empty result is citable only as an absence. Direct OT 25.09 associations per data type; scores are comparable only within one data type.

disease_id.description: Accepts ot_disease, disease_name; resolved to one ot_disease (unknown values are errors, never empty results).

min_score.description: Keeps rows with score >= this value; unknown values never pass. Defaults to 0.0; pass 0 for no restriction (null is not accepted).

target_id.description: Accepts ensembl_gene, hgnc_symbol; resolved to one ensembl_gene (unknown values are errors, never empty results).
